meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为电商商品写图片文案：先问产品名、卖点、目标用户，再按四段结构产出带 emoji 标题的 Markdown 文案，也能优化已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或文案优化需求时触发，例如为智能家居、数码配件等品类的商品写营销文案。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一段电商图片文案，卖点是科学遮光和智能感应光线
say.note: 它会先问产品信息，再按四段结构产出 Markdown 文案

say.text: 把我这段充电宝文案的标题和正文改得更有吸引力，配好 emoji
say.note: 走文案优化流程，重写标题与正文

say.text: 给环保可降解餐具套装写标题，格式用 emoji 加产品昵称加核心卖点
say.note: 输出形如「🌿 绿享餐具：……」的标题

howto.what_en: Claude writes e-commerce image copy for products: it asks for the name, selling points and target users, then outputs a four-part Markdown ad with an emoji title (pain point, intro, selling points, CTA). It also rewrites existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for e-commerce marketing copy or want existing copy improved, e.g. for smart home or digital accessory products.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this sleep mask: light blocking, smart sensing.
say_en.note: It asks for details, then writes the full Markdown copy.

say_en.text: Rewrite the title and body of my power bank copy and fix the emoji.
say_en.note: Runs the copy-optimization flow on title and body.

say_en.text: Give the eco tableware set a title: emoji, product nickname, key selling point.
say_en.note: Outputs a title like “🌿 绿享餐具：…”.
